reviews.title: This app is dead don’t bother
reviews.text: I’ve had it forever and they never update and it just crashed on me anyway. Just don’t bother.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: I don’t like that you have to pay before you can see anything on the app. I saw all of the stars and thought it would be a good app to help me plan my meals. I paid for the app. I was excited. It kept saying downloading your recipes. For 2 days that is all it says. The app doesn’t do anything! I had deleted and reinstalled it. Now I’m out money for absolutely nothing. Very frustrating and disappointing. If you like simply giving money to someone else and getting nothing back, this is the app for you!
